{{Top|leg}}
The '''Black Hammer pirate base''' was the headquarters of the [[Black Hammer pirates]], on [[Galantos]]. Located within the [[Chirk'pn Wastes]], on the edge of the [[Gar'glum Sea]], the base consisted of a number of rusty supply silos and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser batteries]]. [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]] brought their spoils here after raiding ships bound for the city of [[Gal'fian'deprisi]], and the base also received regular tribute from [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] in the city.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
